record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
Location: New York, NY, United States
 
Date Posted: Nov 11, 2026

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

At A&M, the North American Data and AI team, IQx (Official name to be announced) SBU is combining A&M's market-leading execution with AI and digital expertise to help clients redesign processes, improve performance and achieve better outcomes. Come be part of the launch of this cutting-edge team that is making an impact on A&M’s future. Join us in making a difference.

We are seeking a Operations Director to join our team. This position is an internal role within A&M’s IQx operations team, reporting directly to the COO and Finance lead for IQx.

We value a healthy work-life balance and promote in-person collaboration by providing a flexible remote work arrangement with select days in the office, as needed. Ideal office locations are New York City or Philadelphia, but this is flexible.

We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement and building leadership skills. Our business is committed to each team member’s development, training, and exposure to business leaders.

**How you will contribute**

As an Operationsirector, your primary responsibility will be for program management, resource management, onboarding activities, supporting the growth for our business, and helping us thrive to achieve our goals. The Operations Director is expected to grow to support the operations functions of the IQx business more broadly. Your primary responsibilities as we launch will include:

* Lead program management for IQx, including planning, tracking, and driving to completion the initiatives that support the launch and growth of the business
* Support and drive internal initiatives, coordinating across stakeholders, managing timelines and deliverables, and reporting progress to leadership
* Establish and run IQx meeting cadences (e.g., leadership, staffing, and pipeline reviews), including agendas, materials, action tracking, and follow-up
* Help set up and scale the IQx practice, building the operating processes, tools, and governance that will support the team as it grows
* Go-to person for all staffing matters for our business unit
* Assess and plan future resource requirements, driving utilization based on a thorough understanding of current and future project pipeline.
* Build relationships across the business with internal stakeholders including Senior Management, Talent Acquisition, HR, Finance and Operations teams
* Effectively plan for, and advise on conflicts and issues, on a regular basis, prioritizing based on commercial needs and key skills available
* Build awareness of individuals’ performance goals and development needs, influencing resourcing decisions that further the continuation of business and individuals’ skill-set development
* Advanced use of staffing/ workforce planning tools, AI and reporting (for example Profinda, Claude, PowerBI) in measuring utilization and influencing staffing decisions
* Collaborate extensively with the wider Resource Management teams across North America and globally, as required by project needs

**Qualifications**

The ideal candidate will be excited about becoming a true strategic partner for our business. We are looking for people who are personable, knowledgeable, entrepreneurial, and fun. A unique blend of qualities that cannot be fast-tracked into existence. You possess desirable qualities such as being anticipatory, engaged, and respectful, which earns the respect of others. Other preferred experience includes:

* Program management experience, with a track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, managing multiple workstreams, and setting up operating rhythms and meeting cadences
* Resource Manager with several years of experience in a consulting firm or matrix organization; experience in Ops, HR or Recruitment role also beneficial for the role
* Able to effectively partner with Business Leaders and other Resource Managers in the firm, working closely with the wider North America Resource Management leads
* Excellent relationship building skills, communicating with Business Leaders and staff
* Able to manage staffing by efficiently prioritizing multiple competing demands and dealing with tight deadlines
* Able to present meaningful reporting insights to senior leadership, delivering key resourcing messages and driving agreed-upon actions
* Degree educated with several years of work experience in a professional services or corporate environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, and knowledgeable in AI as well as resource planning tools
* Previous experience using a Resource Management/ Planning tool would be advantageous but not essential
* Keen to take on responsibility and grow the role
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, and drive positive change
* Strong time management skills with the ability to plan and priorities workload
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Use initiative to solve problems and make appropriate recommendations for resourcing decisions
* Works well under pressure and with challenging individuals
* Keen to take ownership of resourcing problems and motivated to deliver value

If you see yourself in this description, we want to hear from you!

*How will you grow and be supported?*

Our team prides itself on sustaining a culture that reflects our core values. We value integrity, quality, and objectivity in our work. We believe every day is a choice, and so we like what we do and with whom we do it. We embrace diversity, foster inclusiveness, and reward merit. We encourage and support our employees and communities through ongoing investments from leadership, social and networking events, peer-to-peer networks, Employee Resource Groups, volunteer opportunities, and pro-bono work. We are committed to promoting an inclusive environment in which all can develop, grow, and be supported.

**Your journey at A&M**

We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.

We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.

The salary range is $150,000 - $170,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

**Culture & Values**
--------------------

At Alvarez & Marsal, our core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity guide everything we do, shaping a culture rooted in entrepreneurship, impact, and integrity. We trust our people to take ownership early, contribute to meaningful challenges, and drive results that matter. We empower growth and champion diverse perspectives. Above all, we value doing the right thing. For those ready to roll up their sleeves, lead with integrity, and be difference makers, this is where it starts.

------------------------------

**Unsolicited Resumes from Third-Party Recruiters**
---------------------------------------------------

Please note that as per A&M policy, we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters unless such recruiters are engaged to provide candidates for a specified opening. Any employment agency, person or entity that submits an unsolicited resume does so with the understanding that A&M will have the right to hire that applicant at its discretion without any fee owed to the submitting employment agency, person or entity.

postingQuotes: We are growing rapidly across multiple product lines and sites, and this role will own the quality workflows inside Forge, our homegrown Manufacturing Execution System, and the Quality Intelligence Hub, our centralized analytics and compliance layer built on Databricks.

Senior Manager of Digital Quality Systems
Anduril’s Quality organization is seeking a Senior Manager, Digital Quality Systems to lead the team responsible for our digital quality platform and analytics infrastructure.
Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
IoT-enabled inspection data capture, automated optical inspection or machine vision integration.
Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center.

The right person for this role lives at the intersection of software and quality engineering, someone who can design a data model, review code, ship in sprints, and understand how nonconformance, CAPA, and inspection processes work on a real factory floor.

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The PE Quality Control Head of Department (HOD) is responsible for leading the company's overall quality management function across internal manufacturing processes, suppliers, outsourcing partners, and OEM customers for MOBIS North America Electrified Powertrain, LLC. (MNAe). Reporting to both the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and the Quality Control Head of Group (HOG), the HOD establishes quality strategy, objectives, governance, and priorities; oversees MIP process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, and overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production; leads major investigations and escalations; and ensures that containment, root cause, corrective action, and effectiveness verification are completed to protect customers, stabilize production, and prevent recurrence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** *(To perform within this position successfully, the incumbent must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.)*

* Represent the Quality Control function in executive reviews, customer meetings, supplier escalations, audits, and other strategic business discussions.
* Promote a proactive quality culture, continuous improvement, customer focus, supplier accountability, and workplace safety.
* Define decision-making and escalation authority and make timely quality decisions, including containment, production hold, shipment hold, sorting, rework, and controlled release recommendations when required.
* Supervise, coach, and develop Quality Control HOSs, managers, Assistant Managers, Specialists, and other assigned quality personnel.
* Evaluate departmental capability, workload, staffing, competency, and training needs and allocate resources based on business and quality risk.
* Plan and oversee internal, supplier, customer, and certification audits and ensure timely closure and effectiveness of follow-up actions.
* Lead cross-functional quality decisions and collaboration with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering, Maintenance, Logistics, Purchasing, Supplier Quality, Program Management, and other relevant functions.
* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, internal policies, and applicable quality requirements.
* Develop and continuously improve quality management systems, procedures, standards, inspection controls, traceability, rework controls, NCR processes, Quality Alerts, and escalation processes.
* Review and approve daily, weekly, and monthly departmental quality reports, quality trends, KPIs, recurring issue analysis, and improvement priorities.
* Report quality performance, significant risks, customer and supplier escalations, resource needs, and recovery status directly to the CEO and executive management.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with OEM customers and lead quality communication, claims, audits, investigations, corrective action submissions, and escalation response.
* Maintain management-level communication with outsourcing partners and OEM customers regarding ICCU and HPCU production quality performance, major issues, investigation results, corrective action status, and quality recovery plans.
* Communicate directly with suppliers and oversee supplier quality activities, including supplier containment, investigation, corrective action, response status, escalation, and closure.
* Oversee containment, affected-scope determination, traceability, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and effectiveness verification.
* Ensure issues are properly classified as internal process, supplier, design, logistics, or customer-interface related and assign clear ownership for resolution.
* Lead and approve major investigations involving internal defects, supplier-related issues, customer complaints, field concerns, and quality escalations.
* Direct MIP process quality, supplier quality, and customer quality activities across Stator, Motor, Reducer, PE System, Inverter, and related electrified powertrain products.
* Direct overall process and customer quality management for outsourced ICCU and HPCU production, including outsourcing-partner performance, process controls, change points, audits, defect trends, containment, corrective actions, escalation, and effectiveness verification.
* Establish and execute departmental quality strategy, objectives, policies, governance, priorities, and performance indicators aligned with company business objectives.
* Lead the company's overall quality management activities covering internal manufacturing processes, supplied components, finished products, and OEM customer interfaces.

**Required Knowledge, SkillsAbilities:**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word.
* Working knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, audit management, traceability, containment, and change control.
* Ability to prioritize multiple critical issues, assign ownership, allocate resources, and drive timely closure under production and customer pressure.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and escalation-management skills for interaction with the CEO, executive management, OEM customers, suppliers, and cross-functional leaders.
* Advanced problem-solving and analytical skills using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, and corrective action effectiveness verification.
* Ability to evaluate complex quality risks from company-wide, customer, supplier, financial, operational, and business-continuity perspectives.
* Broad working knowledge of internal process quality, supplier quality, customer quality, quality systems, and automotive manufacturing operations.
* Strong executive leadership, organizational management, people development, and decision-making capabilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.

***AUTHORITYSCOPE***

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

Yes. Provides overall leadership and direction for the PE Quality Control Department, including MIP process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality activities. Supervises assigned quality leaders and personnel and is responsible for work direction, priority setting, resource allocation, coaching, performance feedback, organizational capability, and escalation management in accordance with company policy.

***QUALIFICATIONS***

*(The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required and preferred for this position.)*

**Required EducationExperience:**

* Bachelor's Degree from an accredited institution.
* Five (5) years of leadership experience managing quality teams, cross-functional investigations, and major customer and/or supplier escalations.
* Five (5) years of progressively responsible experience in quality control, quality assurance, supplier quality, customer quality, manufacturing, automotive operations, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
* In lieu of a degree, there is a minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in quality control, quality assurance, supplier quality, customer quality, manufacturing, automotive operations, or an equivalent combination of relevant experience and demonstrated capability.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word, and other business applications.
* Familiarity with occupational hazards and safety precautions.
* Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations:** N/A

**Preferred Education, Experience, and Certified / Licenses:**

* Bachelor's Degree or more advanced degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Quality certifications, such as ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, Certified Quality Engineer, Six Sigma Black Belt, or recognized IATF 16949 auditor training, are preferred.
* Experience managing customer claims, supplier escalations, major containment activities, audits, and executive-level quality reporting preferred.
* Experience leading internal process quality, supplier quality, and OEM customer quality organizations preferred.
* Automotive manufacturing and electrified powertrain quality experience preferred.

**Physical Working Conditions****:**

* Combination of office and manufacturing floor environments, including routine walking and standing within and between production areas and buildings.
* Frequent business travel may be required.
* Must comply with all site safety rules and required personal protective equipment requirements while in manufacturing areas.
* Availability to work extra hours to meet deadlines as required.
* Ability to move across level and uneven surfaces and to sit, stand, stoop, kneel, grasp, push, pull, crawl, climb, and walk.

record.TITLE: Senior Director, Pharmacovigilance Operations & Compliance
record.SCOUT_NOTES: Captured state/board-discovery-report.json; observed 2026-11-12T00:39:58.291Z; posting status UNVERIFIED; job text; proof state/discovery-evidence/33d9f6062c8c7d7a168e656abb7171a4d6b70f70a0e4e816eae0483d97133731.json | discoverySHA=68b7dca1592f67f2ba4adcf35f657617572293b41fa1eebcfe45f30bd1e74cb4 | resumeSHA=3a13fd015d0b6424ad5380457924368dc3bf770018211fd206f425b78a89a640 | Title selected as MFG_PR
record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNA TM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand ( APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit www.veratx.com .

 

 At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney. 

 
 
 
 
 Position Summary: 

 
 
 
 
 This position is responsible for creating, directing, and managing the company’s infrastructure and staff to support the operational aspects of the pharmacovigilance operations and compliance system to adhere to all global regulatory requirements and internal processes and procedures. The qualified candidate will have experience in and perform multiple activities related to overall safety operations strategy across the portfolio, including oversight of case management, database strategy, vendor oversight, compliance, inspection readiness, contracts, departmental strategy and training. In addition, this position must build and maintain relationships with key strategic internal and external stakeholders, including the hiring and development of Drug Safety and Pharmacovigilance (DSPV) personnel. As a member of the DSPV leadership team, this role partners closely with the Head of DSPV to shape PV Operations strategy, own budget and resourcing decisions, and represent DSPV Operations to senior leadership and external partners.

 
 
 
 
 Responsibilities: 

 
 
 
 
 
 Own and drive global PV Operations strategy, including planning, implementation, and management, in the US and globally internationally, in close alignment with the Head of DSPV on portfolio-level risk, resourcing, and business priorities.

 Serve as a key advisor to the Head of DSPV on operational risk, resource allocation, and DSPV budget planning; own accountability for the DSPV Operations budget, including CRO and vendor contract spend.

 Represent DSPV Operations in interactions with senior leadership and, as needed, and support due diligence activities (e.g., licensing, partnerships, M&A).

 Manage internal and external staff allocated to operational PV activities, creating a highly efficient team.

 Own talent strategy for PV Operations, including hiring, development, performance management, and succession planning.

 Provide expert guidance and leadership both internally and externally based on in-depth knowledge of development and post-marketing safety requirements, per ICH, US and international regulations and guidelines, and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice.

 Build and implement pharmacovigilance systems that are fully compliant with the applicable worldwide Health Authority PV regulations.

 Provide oversight of systems and MedDRA updates in collaboration with the relevant PV vendor.

 Contribute to the selection of PV vendors to support an outsourced PV business model. Provide vendor oversight and management for all outsourced or insourced PV activities, including establishing and monitoring key quality and compliance metrics, invoicing and budgetary needs related to operations and compliance.

 Develop and implement an inspection readiness program with the contribution of other PV and non-PV stakeholders.

 Serve as the PV Operations lead/host during Health Authority inspections and audits (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA), coordinating responses and remediation.

 Responsible for a compliant and quality execution of all operational activities related to case management and related activities. Oversee timely submissions of expedited reports to the FDA and other health authorities in conjunction with Regulatory.

 Establish a system for identifying, preventing, and correcting compliance deviation, including applicable corrective and preventive actions, in collaboration with the Quality group and internal/external stakeholders, to maintain reporting compliance at the highest level.

 Oversee the setup of new safety projects, including development of study-specific Safety Management Plans and setup of safety systems and database configurations in the PV database to accommodate these trials and products.

 Contribute to, draft, and implement department SOPs and work instructions related to the PV activities.

 Contribute to the signal detection, benefit-risk profile assessment, and aggregate reporting activities with providing accurate reports from the safety database.

 Effectively collaborate with key stakeholders at all levels in the organization, including Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Medical Affairs, and Manufacturing to develop compliant procedures in line with industry standards and best practices.

 Represent PV Operations as a leader on project teams, cross-functional committees, and governance bodies (e.g., Safety Management Team), providing operational input to signal review and safety governance processes.

 Elevate a quality mindset across DSPV.

 Lead training activities, including setting training requirements and training compliance.

 Build and oversee PV regulatory intelligence activities.

 
 

 
 
 
 
 Qualifications: 

 
 
 
 
 
 Healthcare or life sciences degree required; advanced degree (e.g., PharmD, RN, MPH, or scientific PhD) preferred.

 15+ years of pharmacovigilance experience, including 5+ years in a people-leadership role managing global PV teams.

 Experience with clinical and commercial lifecycle phases is required.

 Demonstrated experience managing PV Operations through multiple Health Authority inspections (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA).

 Experience spanning both clinical-stage and commercial/post-marketing environments, ideally across multiple therapeutic areas.

 Skilled in process gap assessments and process enhancements.

 Strategic thinker.

 Strong execution and drive for results skills.

 Comfortable working independently.

 Deep knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations and guidelines.

 
 
 
 
 Vera Therapeutics Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

 Vera Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

 For this role, the anticipated base pay range is
 $270,000 — $370,000 USD 


 At Vera, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Vera Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays. 

 Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies 

 Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Vera Therapeutics through this page. All recruitment vendors (search firms, recruitment agencies, and staffing companies) are prohibited from contacting our hiring manager(s), executive team members, or employees.

 We require that all recruiters and staffing agencies have a fully executed, formal written agreement on file.

 Vera Therapeutics’ receipt or acceptance of an unsolicited resume submitted by a vendor organization to this website or employee does not constitute an actual or implied contract between Vera Therapeutics and such organization and will be considered unsolicited and Vera Therapeutics will not be responsible for related fees.

 Fraud Alert 

 To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are a top priority for us. At Vera Therapeutics, recruiters only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at https://veratx.com/careers/ .

 Recruiters will always contact you using the domain of veratx.com. We will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from Vera Therapeutics, please email human resources.

 CA Privacy Notice 

 Applicants residing in California should review our California Privacy Notice for Employees, Job Applicants, and Contractors, which describes the categories of personal information we collect, how we use it, and your privacy rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act: https://veratx.com/ca-privacy/ .

### **Job Details:**

JOB SUMMARY Working directly under the VP, Quality Management, provides oversight to designing and administering a comprehensive hospital wide Quality Assurance/Performance Improvement with focus on the Patient Experience that meets organization strategic objectives and improves patient outcomes and quality of care. RESPONSIBILITIES Responsible for directing QA/QI Management activities by identifying areas of potential for improvement in quality, safety or other identified risks in accordance with the department and hospital mission. Directs the collection, measurement and presentation of data required for monitoring performance improvement and quality initiatives regardingpatient satisfaction and experience.Oversees and designs quality dashboards as appropriate Provides leadership to the Medical Staff in identification of quality and performance improvement opportunities based on department peer review activity and organization-wide quality initiatives data. Communicates and acts as a liaison with outside agencies such as CMS, IPRO,National Research Corporation or other appropriate agency as to ensure compliance with external reporting requirements and improvement initiatives. Works closely with Vice President QualityMgt. and all departments by serving as a resource, facilitator and consultant for hospital wide quality improvement activities including QI Teams, RCAs and other organization projects. Provides leadership to departments and teams in quality improvement activities with the integration of continuous improvement methodologies such as PDSA, Rapid Response processes, Lean Thinking, ISO9001 and performance improvement tools. Responsible forcontributing to the “Quality” section on the hospital intranet site to provide staff updates on organization quality and patient safety initiatives, the Patient Experience activity. Responsible for the review, revisions and leadership of the Hospital Wide Quality Management program so as to include all performance activities and patient experience initiatives. Participates and provides expertise and support to multiple committees and programs within and external to the organization for broadening the opportunities of PI activities as driven by goals for quality, safety and customer relation QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS EXPERIENCE 5 years experience in health care environment–preferable in acute care. At least three years in quality and/or risk management and quality improvement activities is preferred. Current experience in assessment and analysis skills. EDUCATION Registered Nurse with BSN and MSN or other healthcare degree equivalent — desirable. LICENSES/CERTIFICATIONS Advanced computer and analytical skills. Current knowledge of NYS Health Code, DNV Standards, and CMS Quality Initiatives. Continuing education in quality improvement and management of risks. Excellent oral and written communication, interpersonal and presentation skills required. Current NYS RN Licensure. OTHER None specified SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS N/A PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS PHYSICAL ACTIVITY Physical ability to investigate any area of the hospital and off site facilities. Close eye work with use of computer. OTHER PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS Generally none, but may be exposed to hazard during an emergency Ability to use computer keyboard. Skill in writing reports

**About Us:**

**HealthAlliance Hospital**

Posted Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 1:00 AM

Jered LLC, a PAR Systems Company, is seeking a Director of Quality is responsible for the overall leadership, strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of Jered’s Quality function across all United States operations. This role has enterprise-level responsibility for ensuring Jered’s products, manufacturing operations, field service activities, and shipboard work consistently meet contractual, regulatory, U.S. Navy, Department of Defense (DoD), customer, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.

 

The Director of Quality serves as the senior Quality leader for Jered’s U.S. operations and is responsible for establishing a consistent, scalable, and disciplined quality organization capable of supporting the company’s continued growth. This position provides leadership to Quality Engineering, Inspection, and other quality resources across Jered locations and ensures appropriate quality controls are integrated throughout engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, testing, delivery, and field service activities.

 

As a member of Jered’s leadership team, the Director of Quality is expected to proactively identify quality and compliance risks, strengthen processes, develop organizational capability, and partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and other functions to drive a culture of **“Do It Once, Do It Right.”** In addition, the Director of Quality owns all quality-related customer communications including customer complaints and corrective actions and defect notifications.

 

**Success Criteria**

The successful Director of Quality will be a strategic, results-driven leader who provides clear direction, technical expertise, and accountability across Jered’s U.S. Quality operations. This individual will build a consistent, scalable, and high-performing Quality organization that supports business growth while maintaining the independence and integrity needed to uphold customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements. Success will be demonstrated through measurable improvements in First Pass Yield; reductions in nonconformances, rework, and Cost of Poor Quality; effective corrective and preventive actions; and sustained compliance with ISO 9001, NAVSEA, DoD, and other applicable standards.

 

This leader will strengthen Quality Management Systems, establish consistent processes and performance expectations across multiple locations, and proactively identify and mitigate risks throughout manufacturing, supply chain, testing, delivery, and field service operations. The Director will also develop and mentor Quality teams, strengthen technical competencies and workforce readiness, and build effective partnerships with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and senior leadership. Through proactive customer engagement, effective issue resolution, data-driven decision-making, and a commitment to continuous improvement, the Director will help shift the organization’s focus from identifying defects to preventing them. Ultimately, success will be reflected in a culture of shared ownership of quality, stronger customer confidence, improved operational performance, and support for Jered’s long-term growth and commitment to “Do It Once, Do It Right.”

 

**Qualifications**

* + Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Business, or a related technical discipline.
 + 10+ years of progressive Quality leadership experience in complex manufacturing, defense, maritime, shipbuilding, or similarly regulated industries.
 + Demonstrated experience leading Quality functions across multiple facilities, programs, or business operations.
 + Significant experience supporting U.S. Navy or DoD shipbuilding, ship repair, fabrication, or maritime manufacturing programs.
 + Strong knowledge of NAVSEA requirements, military specifications, shipyard quality practices, and government contracting environments.
 + Expert level understanding of ISO 9001 and Quality Management System principles.
 + Demonstrated experience with NCR, MRB, CAPA, root cause analysis, audit, supplier quality, and continuous improvement processes.
 + Proven ability to build, lead, develop, and hold accountable Quality Engineering and Inspection organizations.
 + Experience interfacing with U.S. Government representatives, including DCMA and SUPSHIP, as well as major shipyards and defense customers.
 + Demonstrated ability to use data and quality metrics to identify trends, prioritize risks, and drive measurable improvement.
 + Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Program Management, and senior leadership.
 + Experience with ERP and electronic QMS platforms.
 + Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
 + Ability to obtain and maintain access to military installations, shipyards, and controlled industrial areas.
 + Ability and willingness to travel regularly between Jered U.S. locations, customer facilities, suppliers, and shipyards.
 + Valid, unrestricted U.S. Driver’s License required.
 + US Persons

* Global team recognized for their passion of inventing

* Cutting edge benefit programs that include: 401(k) & matching; Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance; Disability & Life Insurance; PTO, Paid Holidays, & Parental Leave for both Parents; Tuition Reimbursement

Work Model: This is a fully onsite role, with work performed at your designated Regal Rexnord office. 
 

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**SUMMARY**

Regal Rexnord is seeking a hands-on Plant Manager to serve as the operating leader for its filament-bearing production facility in Downers Grove, Illinois. The site manufactures filament-wound composite bearings for aerospace, defense, and heavy-industry applications. This position combines daily production management with overall facility leadership and accountability for safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, maintenance coordination, and continuous improvement.

The successful candidate will translate customer demand into clear daily priorities, lead disciplined execution within an AS9100-certified quality management system, develop frontline employees, and establish a visible, fact-based operating rhythm. This role requires strong floor presence, sound judgment, and the ability to solve problems at their source without compromising safety or compliance.

 
 

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead daily and weekly production execution, including staffing, work-center priorities, material readiness, equipment availability, schedule attainment, and recovery planning.
* Provide senior on-site leadership for routine facility operations and maintain clear ownership for safety, housekeeping, 5S, emergency readiness, contractor activity, and general facility condition.
* Lead a proactive safety culture through employee engagement, hazard identification, floor observations, incident and near-miss follow-up, and timely corrective-action closure.
* Ensure production complies with the AS9100 quality management system, approved work instructions, specifications, inspection plans, traceability requirements, record controls, and change-management processes.
* Partner with Quality to contain nonconforming product, protect customers, complete root-cause analysis, implement corrective action, and verify sustained effectiveness.
* Lead, coach, and hold accountable approximately 25 direct labor and maintenance employees; establish expectations for safety, quality, attendance, teamwork, productivity, and conduct.
* Build staffing, skills, cross-training, and succession plans; ensure employees are trained and qualified before performing assigned work.
* Prioritize maintenance activity based on safety, quality, production risk, and customer need; improve preventive-maintenance discipline and eliminate recurring equipment failures.
* Use daily visual management and tiered escalation to review safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and equipment performance.
* Lead continuous-improvement activity that increases throughput, reduces lead time and inventory, improves labor productivity, and lowers the cost of poor quality.
* Manage controllable spending, overtime, supplies, maintenance expense, and operating variances within delegated authority.
* Provide the General Manager with clear operating updates covering performance, risks, recovery actions, resource needs, and decisions required.
 

 

**Critical Competencies**

* Demonstrated ability to manage safety, quality, production, delivery, labor, maintenance priorities, and operating metrics in a regulated or high-reliability environment.
* Working knowledge of AS9100 or a comparable structured quality management system, including nonconformance control, corrective action, document control, traceability, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP or production-planning systems and the ability to interpret schedules, routers, work instructions, drawings, specifications, inspection information, and operating data.
* Strong communication, structured problem-solving, conflict-resolution, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work regularly on the production floor and respond to operating issues outside normal administrative hours when required.
 

 

**Education and Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant manufacturing leadership experience.
* Five or more years of progressive manufacturing experience, including at least three years leading production employees or manufacturing teams.

The employee must be able to lift and manipulate up to 50 pounds and occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 70 pounds. Must be able to occasionally stand for a portion of shift. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. Per AS9100 requirements, an up-to-date vision test should be made available to management and may be shared with auditors.

The use of safety glasses and safety toe shoes are required.

* Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
* Paid Time Off and Holidays

**About Regal Rexnord**
=======================

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

**Quality Director**

**Aerospace Manufacturing | Senior Leadership Team**

**About Columbia Manufacturing**

Columbia Manufacturing, a member of Collective Manufacturing Group, produces complex fabricated components and assemblies for leading aerospace and power generation engine programs. We are committed to delivering safe, reliable, and compliant products while fostering a culture built on integrity, teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Quality Director who will strengthen our quality culture, develop our people, and help ensure we remain a trusted partner to our customers.

**Position Summary**

The Quality Director is a member of the senior leadership team responsible for ensuring Columbia Manufacturing consistently delivers products that meet customer, regulatory, and internal quality requirements.

This role goes beyond compliance. We are seeking a leader who combines sound judgment, ethical decision-making, objective interpretation of requirements, and strong cross-functional leadership. The successful candidate will guide the organization through customer requirements, industry standards, and business challenges while ensuring quality and integrity remain at the center of every decision. We believe strong teams produce strong results, and cultural fit is as important as technical expertise.

The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader who earns trust, develops people, and works effectively with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and customers. We value practical experience as highly as formal education and welcome candidates who have built their careers through hands-on manufacturing and quality leadership roles.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Quality Management System**

* Maintain and continuously improve the Quality Management System.
* Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and aerospace requirements.
* Promote quality ownership and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Guide Quality Decisions**

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, contractual requirements, and industry standards.
* Provide guidance when requirements are unclear, conflicting, or open to interpretation.
* Lead investigations, corrective actions, and nonconformance resolution using sound judgment and risk-based decision making.

**Partner with Customers and Regulatory Bodies**

* Serve as the primary quality representative to customers, auditors, and regulatory agencies.
* Build trusted relationships and lead internal, customer, and third-party audits.

**Develop People and Culture**

* Lead, mentor, and develop the Quality team.
* Build a high-performing organization through coaching, accountability, and succession planning.
* Foster collaboration and an environment where employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Promote a culture where doing the right thing is always more important than meeting a schedule.

**Contribute to Business Success**

* Partner with Operations and Leadership to improve performance, reduce risk, strengthen organizational alignment, and support growth.
* Balance customer expectations, business priorities, and compliance requirements without compromising quality standards.
* Exercise independent quality authority and be willing to stop production or shipment when requirements have not been met.

**What We’re Looking For**

We recognize that great leaders come from many backgrounds. Candidates may have developed through engineering, manufacturing, inspection, quality systems, operations, military service, trade programs, or traditional degree pathways. Equivalent combinations of education, military training, trade experience, and hands-on manufacturing or quality leadership experience will be fully considered.

We are less concerned with how you gained your experience and more interested in your ability to lead people, interpret requirements, make sound decisions, and uphold quality standards under pressure.

Successful candidates will typically possess:

* Experience leading quality functions within aerospace, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, customer requirements, and specification interpretation.
* Demonstrated ethical leadership, sound decision-making, and the ability to uphold standards under pressure.
* Proven success leading teams and collaborating across departments.
* Strong communication skills and experience working with customers, auditors, and senior leadership.
* Continuous improvement mindset and practical problem-solving ability.

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with aerospace quality standards such as AS9100, AS9110, AS13100, NADCAP, or customer-specific requirements.
* Experience supporting OEM customers such as GE Aerospace, Pratt & Whitney, or similar organizations.
* Quality certifications or advanced education are valued but not required.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Quality Director plays a critical role in protecting our customers, our employees, and our reputation. This leader helps ensure that every product we build meets requirements and that every decision we make reflects our commitment to integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**If you are a leader who values ethics, teamwork, sound judgment, and building strong people and processes, we encourage you to apply.**

Job Description:

Location: Fairfield, OH

Reports To: North American Cluster Leader, SP MDC

**About Schneider Electric**

Schneider Electric is leading the digital transformation of energy management and automation. Our mission is to be your digital partner for Sustainability and Efficiency. We drive innovation in everything we do and empower our employees to make bold decisions.

**Position Summary**

The Manufacturing Plant General Manager will lead the Ohio Modular Data Center facilities (two manufacturing plants and one warehouse), overseeing all aspects of plant & warehouse operations, including production, logistics, engineering, quality, safety, and continuous improvement. This role is critical in driving operational excellence, employee development, and customer satisfaction in a fast-paced, engineer-to-order and design build environment. This includes planning, forecasting, executing, and testing Modular Data Centers.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Define and execute plant strategies aligned with Schneider Electric’s global goals.
* Lead cross-functional teams to deliver on scope, schedule, cost, and quality.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives.
* Foster a culture of safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement.

**Operations Management**

* Oversee daily operations, including production, materials management, engineering, and maintenance.
* Manage plant KPIs, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Validate and execute the Master Production Plan and ensure efficient resource allocation.
* Drive digital transformation and smart manufacturing initiatives using EcoStruxure technologies.

**People & Culture**

* Develop and mentor plant personnel, promoting career growth and engagement.
* Collaborate with HR to implement people management strategies and skills development.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture.

**Customer & Compliance**

* Ensure strong communication with internal and external customers.
* Maintain compliance with government regulations and Schneider Electric policies.
* Lead efforts to improve customer satisfaction through technical and operational excellence.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or Industrial Management.
* Strong experience in manufacturing or industrial operations.
* Proven track record in managing engineer-to-order or design-build environments.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain, and logistics.
* Certified in Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma; PMP certification is a plus.
* Experience with SAP/ERP systems
* Excellent communication, leadership, decision-making, and conflict resolution skills.

**What’s** **in It for You**

* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* Flexible work arrangements and paid family leave.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Opportunities for career advancement and mobility.
* Be part of a company committed to sustainability and innovation.

Local Benefits (English):

At Schneider, we believe that every employee is a talent who deserves equal opportunities. This means you matter. Every individual needs to feel valued, supported, and treated fairly to do their best work.

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: “We see you. We value you”. It’s more than just pay and benefits- it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed for you to perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential to shine as an impact maker.

For this U.S. based position, the expected pay range is USD 208,000 - USD 312,000 per year. This pay range includes base pay and short-term incentives. The compensation range for this full-time position applies to candidates located within the United States. Our pay ranges are determined by reviewing roles of similar responsibility and level. Within the pay range, individual pay is determined by several factors including performance, knowledge, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

**Schneider Electric is there when it matters most to you**

Our Total Rewards package outlines all the benefits and support you’ll enjoy as part of the Schneider Electric team:

**Care for Yourself and Your Family.** We ensure you feel secure with benefits that help you and your family thrive: medical (with member reward points), dental, vision, and basic life insurance, Benefit Bucks (credits to apply towards your benefits), flexible work arrangements, paid family leaves, well-being programs, 12 holidays per year, 20 days of paid time off per year (pro-rated in the first year of employment based on start date).

**Invest and Plan Your Future.** We help you plan and invest for the future with competitive pay and programs: your base salary, short-term incentives or sales incentives, opportunities to own company shares (eligibility depends on start date), and 401(k) + match.

**Grow Your Skills and Career.** We commit to helping you grow with ongoing performance and development conversations, Senior Talent Program, global career opportunities, access to our Schneider Career Hub for new positions, projects, and mentors, and learning platforms like Coursera to equip you with the skills for today and tomorrow.

**Team Up in the Workplace.** We encourage teaming up through project opportunities on the Schneider Career Hub, smart ways to collaborate, celebrating contributions via a recognition program (including service anniversary), sharing your voice in our engagement survey, and fostering an inclusive, caring workplace.

**Support Your Community.** We make a difference in your community with volunteer leave, programs through the Schneider Electric Foundation, initiatives that support youth education, and military leave benefits.

record.EMPLOYER_PRIMARY_BUSINESS:
Since 2018, Elevate Aircraft Seating has been enhancing the passenger experience through innovative aircraft seat design and manufacturing. With locations in California, Washington, and Germany we are guided by creativity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality.

We are looking for a skilled Senior Customer Quality Manager to join our team in Charleston, South Carolina. This is an on-site position based in Charleston, South Carolina. We value teamwork, inclusivity, and continuous professional development, and we offer competitive benefits along with opportunities for growth.

**Export Control Requirements:**

**This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.**

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Senior Manager of Customer Quality serves as the primary quality liaison between Elevate Aircraft Seating's manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring effective communication, timely resolution of quality issues, and alignment with customer and regulatory requirements. This highly visible, customer-facing position is responsible for leading defect investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action coordination while driving quality improvements back into manufacturing operations to prevent recurring issues and strengthen product conformity. The Senior Manager of Customer Quality partners cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and customer stakeholders to drive accountability, proactively address quality concerns, and strengthen customer relationships. This position also provides executive leadership with data-driven reporting on quality performance, emerging risks, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to support informed decision-making and operational excellence.

**SUMMARY OF JOB DUTIES** - **Essential Functions****(Other duties and projects may be assigned or requested.)**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential*

**Customer Quality Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary quality liaison between Elevate manufacturing locations, Onsite Support Services (OSS), Boeing, and airline customers, ensuring alignment on quality concerns, operational priorities, and resolution activities.
* Lead customer-facing quality discussions, providing technically accurate information, objective evidence, and clear communication regarding product conformity, nonconformances, and corrective actions.
* Establish and maintain structured communication cadences with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely escalation, consistent messaging, and accountability for quality-related issues.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive engagement, effective problem-solving, and timely resolution of quality concerns.

**Defect Management & Technical Quality Assurance**

* Lead the investigation, documentation, and resolution of product defects and nonconformances, identifying root causes, points of origin, and appropriate corrective actions across manufacturing, receiving inspection, and final assembly operations.
* Evaluate reported nonconformances against applicable Letters of Conformance (LOCs), approved craftsmanship documentation, engineering specifications, and customer requirements to ensure accurate defect classification and resolution.
* Partner with Boeing and internal Quality and Engineering teams on corrective action investigations, providing technical analysis, objective evidence, and recommendations to support effective resolution.
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of aircraft interior products, functionality, design requirements, and installation processes to effectively evaluate quality concerns and communicate technical findings.
* Coordinate appropriate inspection and acceptance testing support during aircraft installation activities, including verification of electrical connections, mechanical functionality, and applicable acceptance test procedures (ATP).

**Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure customer-facing quality activities align with applicable FAA/EASA regulations, AS9100 standards, customer specifications, and internal Quality Management System (QMS) requirements.
* Maintain accurate, traceable quality documentation and defect records through established systems, including SharePoint, ensuring appropriate stakeholders have access to current information and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate the communication and implementation of applicable service bulletins, engineering changes, and product effectivity requirements across manufacturing locations, OSS, Boeing, and customers.
* Support customer quality reviews, audits, and regulatory compliance activities by providing technical documentation, investigation findings, and corrective action evidence.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive cross-functional corrective and preventive action initiatives to address customer quality concerns, eliminate recurring defects, and strengthen manufacturing process effectiveness.
* Translate customer quality feedback, defect trends, and investigation findings into actionable improvement opportunities for manufacturing, Engineering, and Quality teams.
* Apply root cause analysis, statistical methods, and structured problem-solving techniques to validate defect origins, assess corrective action effectiveness, and support sustainable improvements.
* Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues, proactively escalating concerns and coordinating mitigation activities to minimize customer impact and prevent recurrence.

**Executive Reporting & Cross-Functional Quality Performance**

* Develop and present quality performance reports, defect trends, corrective action status, and emerging risks to executive leadership, providing data-driven insights and recommendations to support operational decision-making.
* Establish and monitor key quality performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer defects, resolution timelines, recurring issues, and corrective action effectiveness.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and OSS teams to drive accountability, coordinate issue resolution, and ensure timely implementation of quality improvements across affected operations.
* Monitor customer quality deliverables, open issues, and corrective action commitments to ensure alignment with program milestones, customer expectations, and organizational quality objectives.

**Other**

* Maintain a safe, secure and legal work environment, adhering to all Company policies and procedures.
* Protect the confidentiality of the Company’s information and products.
* Contribute to team efforts by performing other job-related duties and projects as assigned or requested.

**GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS – Education, Knowledge, and Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in quality assurance, quality engineering, or quality management within aerospace manufacturing or a related highly regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and present quality performance metrics, defect trends, corrective action status, and risk assessments to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record of leading cross-functional quality improvement initiatives, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and translating customer quality concerns into sustainable manufacturing improvements.
* Extensive background in defect investigations, root cause analysis, nonconformance management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across manufacturing and customer operations.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a primary quality interface with customers, including managing complex quality concerns, presenting technical findings, and driving issue resolution.
* Minimum of 5 years working with aerospace quality standards, FAA/EASA regulatory requirements, product conformity, and applicable customer quality requirements.

**Skills:**

* In-depth knowledge of AS9100 standards, FAA/EASA regulations, aerospace quality requirements, product conformity, and applicable airworthiness standards.
* Strong technical understanding of aircraft interior products, manufacturing processes, installation requirements, and quality documentation, including Letters of Conformance (LOCs) and approved craftsmanship standards.
* Advanced proficiency in nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and evidence-based defect investigation and resolution.
* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to present complex technical findings, resolve customer concerns, and influence internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret quality data, identify trends, evaluate risks, and present actionable recommendations to executive leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, establish structured communication processes, drive accountability, and implement sustainable quality improvements without direct supervisory authority.

**Preferred Skills/Experience:**

* Familiarity with Boeing quality requirements, customer-specific specifications, craftsmanship standards, and aircraft final assembly or onsite support operations.
* Formal training or practical experience conducting customer, regulatory, or third-party quality audits within the aerospace industry.
* Working knowledge of advanced quality methodologies, including APQP, FMEA, Statistical Process Control (SPC), and AS9145 requirements.
* Proficiency in AS9102 First Article Inspection (FAI) requirements, Material Review Board (MRB) processes, and aerospace product conformity documentation.
* Knowledge of aircraft interior systems, including seating, electrical and mechanical functionality, installation processes, and acceptance testing procedures (ATP).

**Other:**

* Extended or irregular hours may be required.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.
* Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.
* Elevate Aircraft Seating is an “at-will” employer; employment is at the mutual consent of both the employee and the employer, and may be terminated at will for any reason, with or without cause, at any time during employment with the Company.
* As business conditions warrant a change in the operating necessities of the Company, all employees are expected to react productively, handle other essential tasks assigned now or in the future.
* Tasks may vary slightly based on products produced at a division.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES AND LICENSE**

* N/A

**SUPERVISION PROVIDED TO THE POSITION**

* Direction is provided for assignments in terms of desired outcome (goals), timing and budget.
* Work is reviewed or measured in terms of meeting organizational objectives and schedules.

**LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITY**

* Oversee the work of others.
* Assist with coordination of adherence to organizational goals, operating policies, and budgetary guidelines.

**PROBLEM SOLVING**

* Develop and provide solutions to complex problems based on established precedents and are consistent with organization objectives.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS** 
*Elevate Aircraft Seating offers competitive wages and benefits to recognize employees for their work. The base pay offered will vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, location, experience and take into account internal equity.*

**Hourly Rate Transparency:** $100,000- $180,000 annually

**Featured Benefits:**

* Generous 401(K) matching with immediate eligibility and vesting
* 3 weeks of Paid Time Off
* 12 paid holidays
* Affordable health care plans for yourself and your family
* And so much more!

**Other Perks:**

* On-site gym
* Free electric car charging stations
* Potential for growth within organization
* Supportive workplace environment with a team-oriented culture

**Company****:**
================

AHI agilon health, inc.

**Job Posting Location****:**
=============================

Remote - USA

**Job Title****:**
==================

Regional Director, Operations

**Job Description****:**
========================

***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship, now or in the future.***

The Regional Director of Operations has end-to-end operational accountability for planning, execution, and continuous improvement of market-level Risk Adjustment (BOI), Quality (HEDIS) and Cost of Care operation programs across multiple markets. This role owns operational processes, staffing, budgets, vendor relationships, data and technology enablement, and performance outcomes. The Director partners with platform BOI/Quality, Market Medical Directors, IT/Engineering, Data & Analytics, Finance and RBEs/providers to deliver compliant, scalable, and measurable operational performance.

*This role requires travel 4–10 days per month to visit partner groups*

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Operational Leadership & Execution – 45%**

* Lead and operationalize BOI, Quality and Cost of Care programs across 3+ markets; develop and enforce SOPs, SLAs and RACI for all program activities.
* Collaborate with Central Operations to manager operation, performance and outcomes related to pre-visit record review, post-visit coding review, chart collection, query workflows and provider engagement processes.
* In close partnership with the Market Leader and market operations team, oversee market operations, monitor performance, and implement corrective action and performance improvement plans.
* Define operational KPIs, run root cause analysis, lead process improvement efforts and institutionalize best practices across markets.
* Serve as the escalation point for market operational issues and lead cross-functional readiness for new initiatives.
* Provide oversight of operating budgets for BOI/Quality (labor, contractors, vendor spend); forecast resource needs and identify cost-to-serve improvements.

**Data & Technology Ownership – 35%**

* Partner with Data & Analytics and IT/Engineering to define technical requirements, data pipelines, EMR/claims integrations, and dashboards to support risk capture and quality improvement.
* In partnership with Tech, innovate on and participate in testing of solutions that drive automation and technology enablement to reduce manual effort and increase operational scale.

**People & Capacity – 20%**

* In collaboration with and informed by input from the Regional President, lead capacity planning, staffing models, recruitment, training and performance management for market BOI/Quality operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Minimum Experience:**

* 5+ years healthcare operations experience; 3+ years leading multi-market risk adjustment or quality programs

**Education/Licensure:**

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
* Six Sigma/Lean certification preferred

**Skills and Abilities:**

* Solid knowledge of HEDIS, risk adjustment coding and healthcare data (claims/EMR)
* Demonstrated management of operational teams and vendor partners
* Analytics fluency (dashboards/KPI’s and either direct SQL or close collaboration with analytics teams)
* Proven program and project management skills and process improvement experience
* *Language Skills:* Strong communication skills both written and verbal to work with multiple internal and external clients in a fast-paced environment
* *Mathematical Skills:* Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
* *Reasoning Ability:* Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
* *Computer Skills:* Ability to create and maintain documents using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)

**Essential Physical Functions:**

These are requirements normally expected to perform regular job duties. Incumbent must be able to successfully perform all the functions of the job with or without accommodation.
